name: Affogato al Caffè
description: A scoop of vanilla gelato 'drowned' in a shot of hot espresso, the perfect intersection of dessert and coffee.
ingredients: a handful of fresh sage, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with extra-virgin olive oil.
In a large bowl, whisk together the fresh lasagna sheets and cracked black pepper until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the balsamic vinegar with the whole milk until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 0 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
Garnish with basil or a dusting of lemon zest.
Slice or portion into servings and serve.
tips: Bring your balsamic vinegar to room temperature before mixing for a smoother, more even texture.
This keeps well for a couple of days in an airtight container, and the flavor often improves overnight.
Resist opening the oven door too early — a sudden change in temperature can cause the dessert to sink or crack.
